title: Grammar, Translation and Claude Usage
goal: Align the two text tools and improve multi-profile quota scanability while preserving existing behavior.
dependencies: Phase 4 has gate.status = passed and all required evidence recorded
preserve: English Grammar, Vietnamese-default Translation with English option, editable result
Dashboard and hotkey input, UI Automation fallback to paste, clipboard behavior
Existing profile IDs, quota windows, alerts, token refresh, widget styles, locks and hook settings
Theme and Local AI setup from prior phases
implementation: Use consistent input/output, processing, retry and copy states. Preserve user edits and input across recoverable errors.
Maintain selected-text quick popup when available and clear manual paste fallback. Keep OCR text handoff intact.
Order Claude Usage attention states deterministically. Show quota and reset separately for 5h and 7d, last refresh, stale/error and actual hook state.
Surface widget/alerts/hook settings separately from account list while preserving all keys and existing behaviors.

Keep edited output copyable and do not let a stale or failed inference overwrite a newer draft or an edit made while it was running. Verify that quota priority does not claim active blocking without the real hook state.

automated.expected: Grammar and Translation open correctly with and without selected input, can retry on failure, and copy edited text. OCR handoff still arrives.
automated.evidence: Exact native WebView2 dashboard_ui suite passed. Covers selected and blank shortcut state, draft/edit preservation against stale success/failure, retry, output copying and OCR handoff. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45881461545/job/140121564138

real_ui.steps: Run both tools from Dashboard and hotkey. Test selected text, no selection, paste, destination selection, editing and copying.
real_ui.expected: Correct tool opens and can complete each path. Copy contains user-edited output.
real_ui.evidence: Actual Windows tray Ctrl+Alt+G/T both selected text and no-selection; native Ctrl+V, native clicks and editable Grammar/Translation outputs in dashboard and quick panel. Default VI, English target and actual Windows clipboard checked with a deterministic loopback fixture. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45881461545/job/140121563638

real_ui.steps: Open the fixture with ten profiles covering 5h/7d, a near-threshold profile, stale and login error. Time finding the most urgent profile from open.
real_ui.expected: Target is within 5 seconds. Reset periods and stale, refreshing, login failure and active blocking are distinguishable.
real_ui.evidence: Ten synthetic profiles with actual executable-configured hook, failed login, stale, refresh, missing/dead/disabled hooks and separate 5h/7d resets. Highest urgency visible without scrolling 181 ms after HWND visible (launch-to-visible 6081 ms separately). Hosted mechanical measurement, not a human usability study. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45881461545/job/140121563638

real_ui.steps: Open a legacy fixture with widget preferences and hooks. Navigate and reopen after saving an unrelated setting.
real_ui.expected: Existing values render and persist. No actual credentials are used.
real_ui.evidence: Real native settings tabs and unrelated accent change saved and reopened. Widget label/font/opacity/lock, unknown value and all hook settings file SHA-256 preserved. No credentials. https://github.com/rua-den/sig4a/actions/runs/45881461545/job/140121563638

findings.title: Hook preview must reflect executable and authoritative saved-cache decision
findings.resolution: Exact runnable tray command and PE check, no claim from threshold-only; saved/current policy separated, partial quota view handles missing periods.

findings.title: Rate-limited legacy fixture retained cached values and retry
findings.resolution: Scope the 429 regression to its own row, both cached windows and nonzero countdown.
